experiment: bounded applicability check: is the bimodality room_02-specific?

sequence.reference: archived hall_01 clean run: res_hall01_clean_05x.bag poses + clean scans -> reference cloud, the same reference and bounded metric used in C0-C3

run_controls.note: identical to T2/T3a conditions, quiet machine

scoring.alignment: single SE(3) fitted on the first 120 paired keyframes (~12 s), then coverage and patch-unsupported over every paired keyframe with a pose
scoring.metric: bounded NN cap 0.5 m, patch radius 0.30 m, plane RMS 0.02 m
scoring.no_retuning: no ROI, threshold or frame-set change

mode_rule: GOOD unsupported < 0.10, BAD > 0.50, else UNCLEAR (same rule as room_02)

criterion.declared: four runs; if they cross modes the host/config is unstable on this dataset too and single-run factor comparisons stop everywhere; if all four agree, room_02 is recorded as a sequence-specific degradation case
criterion.forbidden: no medians or cherry-picked initialisations to call a lucky run 'controlled'

record: per-run group statistics from the DET_SYNC log
service population (declared frames, frames with output, missing)
